final_message:
I wrote `tests/test_expiring_today.py`. It replays the recording and fails for the reason the scenario names. It adds milk (expires 2026-10-21) and yogurt (expires 2026-10-23), then asks `GET /items/expiring?days=3&today=2026-10-21`. The code returns only yogurt, so milk is missing.

The test expects `[milk, yogurt]` in that order, which is the order in the recording's `expected` field. I changed no source and no existing test.
